24 open-source Amazon Kindle projects built by reverse engineering

Open-source projects that exist because someone reverse engineered Amazon Kindle e-readers and ebook formats. 13 of 24 had a commit in the last 12 months. Most-starred: KOReader, calibre, Kindle_download_helper, obsidian-kindle-plugin, KindleUnpack.
